source_scope: Frozen prompt bytes match the implementation constant; model API evaluation is not a built/live application verification.

corpus.reference_status: Before/after agent silver adjudication; operator adjudication is pending. Eight noise controls are inferred from recognizer agreement, not independently listened to.

production_prompt.scope: Static byte identity only; not a build or live-app verification.

method.arm_order: Seed 20261102, randomized sequential arms within each take; no paid retries. Final blind grading uses a new opaque-label shuffle.
method.scorer: Unchanged examples/eval/wer.rs (cantrip-ascii-v1), called through a private std-only native adapter.
method.noun_spans: Reference occurrences matched case-insensitively to canonical vocabulary; output occurrences require exact spelling and case. Count-matched precision/recall is provisional, not a semantic entity annotator.
method.cleanup_grading: Human-agent blind review of every completed private output and every non-exact control. Independently authored exact-accepted outputs provide deterministic fidelity/readability oracles. No paid judges.
method.quality_gate: Complete final arm: zero private factual/modality/number/negation/identifier/speech-act failures, zero behavior fidelity failures, zero empty-input inventions, and the incident name corrected.
method.selection: Highest private readability among qualified final arms; within 0.15 points prefer lower private p95, then cost.
method.routing: Provider fallbacks disabled. Cleanup enforces provider.max_price at reviewed standard token prices, with no temperature, generation cap, reasoning.exclude, or Ollama think override. The app does not send these provider guards.
method.timeout_scope: 30-second client socket timeout in the private cleanup runner; not proof of the application shared deadline. Selected-arm observed maximum was below 30 seconds.
method.counter_guard: Authoritative eval-key counter read before every final one-call batch. Absolute key usage plus the full next-call reservation must be <=$4.50. Append-only reconciliation retains every unknown flag; no reset or paid failed-call retry.

native_baseline.timing: Cold CLI process per clip; includes model load, pipeline, archive and stdout. No live app/config/keyring changes.

lanes.cost_status: unknown_total; reported sum is only a lower bound

exceptions.initial_hone_prompt: Rejected on observed fidelity failures; a focused fidelity-first revision was frozen before its evaluation on the same private set and two additional synthetic regressions. Initial failures remain in the receipt.

daily_cleanup.credential: Use the operator-owned daily credential; no live app, configuration, or keyring changes were made.

recommendation.why: Only the final Sol arm completed all 56 cases with zero observed hard fidelity or empty-input failures. The incident name was corrected. The earlier Hone candidate is rejected, not silently re-scored.
recommendation.stt: Keep local Parakeet v3 int8 as the default. MAI-Transcribe-2 is the strongest viable cloud alternative in these observations, but silver-reference selection bias, five public clips, and cold local timings do not justify a default switch before operator adjudication.
recommendation.local_cleanup: Withdrawn by operator after memory pressure; no promotion claim.

limitations: [MEASURED] The private speech set has 16 takes, not 24 successful speech dictations; eight selected nonempty WAVs are noise controls. One operator, English-only, mostly technical/project speech.
[UNVERIFIED] No audio was independently listened to and no operator adjudication has happened. Before/after scores are agent silver phases, not human ground truth.
[MEASURED] Strict noun precision retains four unresolved silver-reference mismatches instead of changing the gold after seeing the winning output.
[INFERRED] The observed improvements support this operator profile only; one repetition and a single human-agent grader do not establish population reliability or a stable tail latency.
[MEASURED] Local STT timings are cold CLI processes including load/archive/output; historical warm-path timings are separate and not a fresh controlled cloud comparison.
[UNVERIFIED] Live app release-to-text, clipboard delivery, and the new compiled artifact were not exercised in this private study. Hosted CI and the ordinary review gate remain required before merge.
[MEASURED] Counter lookups occur outside model request timing and pace later requests; provider routing, cache state, network conditions, and host load were not controlled.
[MEASURED] The operator withdrew local-gemma after memory pressure; no further local models, STT, builds/tests, VMs, or browser automation ran after that hold.
[MEASURED] Public receipts contain aggregates, public model metadata, and hashes only. Audio, text, original take IDs, vocabulary strings, per-call outputs, and adjudication choices remain private.
